Document title: 安徽省贯彻落实《深入实施以人为本的新型城镇化战略五年行动计划》实施方案
Summary: Provincial plan calls for lawful-rental settlement and specified employment/social-insurance-based routes for Hefei, with public-service expansion goals.
Finding: Hefei urban-core settlement path in the provincial plan refers to six months of eligible insurance or provident-fund contributions, reduced to three months for applicants under 45; application particulars need municipal verification.

Document title: 北京市积分落户管理办法
Summary: Beijing uses a points-based annual application system for qualifying applicants; qualifying conditions and annual places are specified in the regulation. This is one route, not an exhaustive inventory of all settlement routes.
Finding: The points-based route includes qualification thresholds and annual government-determined settlement scale; not a measure of school or housing access.

Document title: 北京市人力资源和社会保障局关于开展2026年北京市积分落户申报工作的通告
Government agency: Beijing Municipal Human Resources and Social Security Bureau
Summary: Sets the 2026 application timetable and administrative guidance for the existing points-based settlement mechanism.
Finding: Annual administrative implementation notice, not a new comprehensive settlement regime.

Document title: 重庆市户口迁移登记实施办法
Summary: Establishes differentiated hukou transfer requirements across Chongqing’s core metropolitan area, north-east and south-east regions for work, residence, family and other routes.
Finding: Municipality-wide regulation with important internal regional differences; current validity and subsequent changes require continued review.

Document title: 福建省居民户口登记管理办法
Summary: Provincial regulation on hukou registration and transfer processes, as originally enacted in 2016; current amendments and legal status must be checked before interpreting it as the complete 2026 framework.
Finding: Historical legal source; later implementation and amendments not yet systematically audited.

Document title: 福建省户口居民身份证管理工作规定
Summary: Provincial public security department rules governing hukou and resident ID card administration; superseded the 2017 provincial implementing rules referenced by the notice.
Finding: Administrative procedures, not complete coding of all municipal settlement routes.

Document title: 甘肃省深入实施以人为本的新型城镇化战略五年行动计划方案
Summary: Plan states a province-wide zero-threshold urban settlement policy and calls for household registration process simplification and wider residence-based public-service coverage.
Finding: Zero-threshold is a provincial policy statement; city-level documentation, public rental housing conditions and service uptake are not established here.

Document title: 东莞市人民政府办公室关于深化户籍制度改革的实施意见
Summary: Dongguan revises local hukou application procedures and directs departments to coordinate migrant access to education, housing and social services.
Finding: A city-specific rule: settlement rules and required documents must not be generalised to Guangzhou, Shenzhen or the whole province.

Document title: 贵州省落实以人为本的新型城镇化战略五年行动计划实施方案（2024—2028年）
Summary: The provincial plan reiterates removal of settlement restrictions in urban areas and promotes residence-based services and public-service infrastructure.
Finding: The provincial settlement policy is broad, but service access and documentation need municipal verification; the 2025 web publication republishes a provincial plan.

Document title: 广西壮族自治区人民政府关于进一步推进全区户籍制度改革的指导意见
Summary: Guangxi guidance allows applicants with legal stable employment or accommodation (including rental) to apply in urban jurisdictions, with local governments defining relevant terms.
Finding: A region-wide settlement pathway exists, but local definitions of stable employment and residence remain the operative test; public-service text sets policy directions.

Document title: 海南省高校毕业生就业创业支持措施（落户部分）
Government agency: Hainan Human Resources and Social Security Authorities
Summary: Graduates meeting degree and time-since-graduation requirements may settle before securing employment in most of Hainan, excluding Sansha under the cited measure.
Finding: This is a graduate-specific pathway, not a universal Hainan urban settlement rule; other migrant groups and other services require separate regulations.

Document title: 河北省国民经济和社会发展第十五个五年规划纲要（城镇化相关章节）
Summary: The plan calls for relaxing urban settlement, implementing residence-based services and greater migrant access to schooling, urban housing support and insurance.
Finding: Provincial 2026 planning objectives are recorded, but local application thresholds and effective entitlement remain city-specific and unverified.

Document title: 河南省国民经济和社会发展第十五个五年规划纲要（城镇化相关章节）
Summary: Plan calls for easier household registration, equal access to urban services for unregistered residents and broader insurance, housing and education coverage.
Finding: Province-wide objectives are identified, not city admission standards or social-benefit entitlements.

Document title: 黑龙江省人力资源社会保障厅等14部门关于进一步加强农民工服务保障工作的实施意见
Government agency: Heilongjiang Human Resources and Social Security Department et al.
Summary: Multi-agency provincial provisions reiterate zero-threshold settlement in urban areas, expand migrant children's school access and protect workers' social-insurance rights.
Finding: Provincial implementation measures assert province-wide zero-threshold urban registration; school place allocation and benefit access still need institution-specific rules.

Document title: 湖北省公安机关户籍窗口工作规范（试行）
Summary: Standardises police household-registration counters and procedural service across Hubei.
Finding: Procedural rules complement, but do not replace, Wuhan's distinct settlement policy.

Document title: 湖北省国民经济和社会发展第十五个五年规划纲要（第十章）
Summary: The plan calls for eliminating settlement restrictions outside Wuhan, changing Wuhan’s points mechanism and extending residence-based public services. This is a provincial planning commitment, not independent proof that every city has implemented the commitments.
Finding: Provincial planning baseline; municipal rules and operational status require separate verification.

Document title: 湖南省户口登记管理办法
Summary: Sets province-level administrative rules for household registration and maintains a unified resident-hukou classification; individual eligibility rules still require case-specific reading.
Finding: Provincial registration administration measure; the existence of the rule does not establish service access.

Document title: 省政府关于开展苏南重点城市要素市场化配置综合改革试点的通知
Summary: A provincial notice establishes local pilot plans in five southern Jiangsu cities, including settlement and public-service-related priorities. It does not apply uniformly to every Jiangsu municipality.
Finding: City-limited pilot framework and planning evidence, not a province-wide enacted eligibility rule.

Document title: 吉林省公安机关户口和居民身份证管理工作规范
Summary: Provincial administrative rules on residence, household registration, identity management and movement of registration; municipal conditions still require examination.
Finding: Administrative registration framework, not a province-wide school/housing eligibility finding.

Document title: 江苏省深入实施以人为本的新型城镇化战略五年行动计划实施方案
Summary: Jiangsu calls on Nanjing and Suzhou to continue optimising settlement and seeks provision of basic services to the resident population.
Finding: The plan describes future implementation directions and does not prove that Nanjing and Suzhou applicants face identical hukou or service conditions.

Document title: 关于进一步深化户籍制度改革的意见（赣公发〔2025〕3号）
Government agency: Jiangxi Provincial Public Security et al.
Summary: The province-wide reform opinion simplifies registration, provides residence-permit recognition across the province and promotes residence-based service delivery.
Finding: A Jiangxi-wide reform directive is indexed, including provincial permit reciprocity; local school placement, public rental housing and insurance implementation rules require separate checks.

Document title: 关于印发《全省公安机关17条便民利企新举措》的通知
Summary: One measure allows adults who have resided in provincial urban areas for over six consecutive months to apply for settlement with a residence permit, with provisions for family members.
Finding: Provincial administrative measure; proof of effective local uptake not yet assessed.

Document title: 国务院关于进一步推进户籍制度改革的意见
Summary: Established differentiated settlement reform priorities and called for expanding basic public services for the resident population. This is a national directive, not proof of local implementation.
Finding: National policy baseline

Document title: 深入实施以人为本的新型城镇化战略五年行动计划
Summary: Calls for relaxing settlement restrictions outside certain megacities and widening basic services for permanent residents, with provinces responsible for coordination and local governments for implementation.
Finding: National policy baseline

Document title: 国务院关于推行常住地提供基本公共服务的实施意见
Summary: Calls for improving migrant children’s schooling, extending public rental housing to eligible non-local-hukou residents and removing hukou-based barriers to local employee social insurance. Local eligibility and delivery require separate verification.
Finding: National policy baseline

Document title: 中华人民共和国国民经济和社会发展第十五个五年规划纲要（第三十一章）
Government agency: National People’s Congress / published by Ministry of Education
Summary: Sets national priorities including points-based settlement reforms, expansion of public rental housing eligibility and education access for qualifying migrant children.
Finding: National planning framework

Document title: 内蒙古自治区人民政府办公厅关于全面放开城镇落户限制深化户籍制度改革的实施意见（政府转载）
Government agency: Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region Government Office
Summary: The republished regional directive allows rural and pastoral migrants to apply for urban hukou based on lawful stable residence (including rental) or stable work, without additional residence or insurance durations described in the cited passage.
Finding: Regional settlement framework identified; original issuance/effectiveness date has not been established from the repost, so the recorded date is the republication date.

Document title: 宁夏回族自治区深入推进新型城镇化五年行动方案（2023—2027年）
Government agency: Ningxia Urbanisation Working Group via Housing Department
Summary: Five-year plan calls for cancellation of urban settlement restrictions throughout Ningxia, residence-based services and improved housing, education and insurance support.
Finding: Regional zero-threshold reform is included in the plan; municipal service eligibility criteria are not demonstrated.

Document title: 宁夏回族自治区农业农村厅对政协提案的答复（户籍改革段）
Government agency: Ningxia Department of Agriculture and Rural Affairs
Summary: Official 2025 reply reports a 2025 regional party/state directive removing urban settlement restrictions and describes permit-associated basic services.
Finding: Administrative self-report of policy adoption; effectiveness and detailed service conditions are not independently measured.

Document title: 2025年青海省政府工作报告（城镇化和基本公共服务部分）
Summary: Government work report endorses residence-based services, migrant children's schooling and housing measures; separate reports describe a province-wide zero-threshold settlement direction.
Finding: A policy direction is evidenced; operational thresholds and the legal text of the urban settlement rule are not independently established in this indexed record.

Document title: 青海省发展改革委安排新型城镇化建设资金的情况通报
Government agency: Qinghai Provincial Development and Reform Commission via NDRC
Summary: Qinghai authorities report infrastructure investment aimed at improving city and county capacity, explicitly identifying residence-based public-service gaps.
Finding: An implementation/capacity report, not an applicant eligibility standard.

Document title: 烟台市人民政府办公室关于修改并继续执行深化户籍管理制度改革实施意见的通知
Summary: Yantai continues residence- and employment-based urban settlement and directs coordination of municipal education, housing and health services.
Finding: This is a Yantai example, not proof of identical current requirements across all Shandong municipalities.

Document title: 山西省公安机关户籍管理工作规范
Summary: The provincial police household-registration norm standardises registration, migration processes and document handling. The online copy specifies application from 2024-01-01.
Finding: A provincial procedural framework is available; it does not by itself establish every municipality's settlement thresholds.

Document title: 上海市教育委员会关于2026年上海市义务教育阶段学校招生入学工作的实施意见
Summary: For 2026 compulsory-school admission, a migrant child must have a valid Shanghai residence permit or residence-registration certificate; one parent must hold a valid residence permit and meet either six months of local employee social insurance within the stated annual window or three continuous years of flexible-employment registration. District-level arrangements still apply.
Finding: Conditional eligibility documented; actual access and outcomes not assessed.

Document title: 四川省深入实施以人为本的新型城镇化战略五年行动计划实施方案
Summary: Sichuan plan distinguishes Chengdu's centrally conditioned/points routes from other cities and counties, whose settlement limits it says should be lifted; sets migrant education, housing and insurance directions.
Finding: Chengdu remains a distinct settlement case. Province-wide language on school places, housing and insurance is not proof of present individual eligibility.

Document title: 成都市合法稳定就业和居住落户新政策（人社部转载）
Government agency: Chengdu Municipal Government / Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security
Summary: Central Chengdu pathway described as three years of pension contributions plus a valid residence permit; prior 100-point requirement removed for this pathway.
Finding: City-specific route: three years of continuous pension insurance and a valid permit; not the settlement rule for every Sichuan city.

Document title: 四川省推行常住地提供基本公共服务的实施方案
Summary: October 2026 scheme addresses school access, public rental housing, employer social insurance and residence-based health care for residents lacking local hukou.
Finding: New province-wide implementation scheme; city-level school allocation, housing queues and eligibility criteria remain to be verified.

Document title: 陕西省贯彻深入实施以人为本的新型城镇化战略五年行动计划实施方案
Summary: Shaanxi plan removes settlement restrictions outside Xi'an and pursues flexible rental-based settlement and residence-linked services.
Finding: Xi'an is the explicit exception. Plan language should not be read as verified eligibility for school, housing and social assistance throughout the province.

Document title: 西藏自治区深入推进以人为本的新型城镇化战略五年行动计划实施方案
Government agency: Tibet Autonomous Region Development and Reform Commission
Summary: Plan calls for removing settlement restrictions in county urban areas and towns, expanding residence-permit services, migrant schooling and service provision.
Finding: County town hukou restrictions are addressed at regional-plan level; eligibility in Lhasa and public-service standards cannot be inferred uniformly.

Document title: 天津市居住证管理办法
Summary: Tianjin residence permit regulations establish a points-based settlement channel and permit-linked access provisions; the instrument runs from 2022-01-01 through 2026-12-31.
Finding: Points settlement is subject to a periodically set threshold. Permit holders are addressed in education and basic-service provisions; precise school and insurance entitlement requires implementing regulations.

Document title: 关于提升城市服务保障水平促进新市民安居乐业若干措施
Summary: Measures refer to adjustments to points-based settlement, residence permit conveniences and school pre-registration for permit holders.
Finding: The municipality retained point-based settlement procedures while seeking to ease new-resident service access; this is not an individual admission guarantee.

Document title: 新疆维吾尔自治区户口居民身份证管理工作规定（试行）
Summary: Region-wide household registration and identity-management procedures are set out, but city-specific entry pathways require separate examination.
Finding: Regional police regulation is indexed; no province-wide equal-access conclusion is inferred.

Document title: 乌鲁木齐市人民政府办公室关于进一步做好户口迁入政策服务管理工作的通知（公安厅转载）
Government agency: Urumqi Municipal Government Office / Regional Public Security Department
Summary: Urumqi specified pathways include qualifications-based hukou admission and other applicant categories; policy notice takes effect after a thirty-day interval.
Finding: Urumqi is a municipal case and cannot establish Xinjiang-wide settlement eligibility.

Document title: 云南省公安厅关于推行部分户籍业务容缺受理服务模式和证明事项告知承诺制度的公告
Summary: Announcement permits provisional acceptance for several household-registration procedures, including lawful-rental and stable-employment migration where noncritical supporting material is missing.
Finding: Procedural simplification documented; it does not create an unconditional right to settle or demonstrate actual school/housing access.

Document title: 浙江省人民政府办公厅关于高质量推进户籍制度改革的通知（政策转载解读）
Summary: A provincial reform notice permits hukou registration based on lawful stable residence in most urban jurisdictions while treating Hangzhou separately; it also links residence permits to public services.
Finding: Hangzhou is an explicit settlement exception; the provincial reform text cannot establish the current school or housing eligibility for any specific Zhejiang city.

Document title: 嘉兴市人民政府办公室关于高质量推进户籍制度改革的通知
Summary: Jiaxing permits defined rental-based settlement, qualifying employment-based settlement, residence permit conversion and inter-city social insurance accumulation; its notice applies from 2024-08-01.
Finding: Municipal example: a qualified residence permit holder with six months' registered residence in Zhejiang can apply under the stated local pathway; this rule is Jiaxing-specific.
